pipelines.name: Dependency audit

steps.name: Audit npm templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in node/*/ node-typescript/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}package-lock.json" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  npm audit --prefix "$dir" || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Audit bun templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in bun/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}package.json" ] || continue
  [ -f "${dir}bun.lock" ] || [ -f "${dir}bun.lockb" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && bun audit) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Audit PHP templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in php/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}composer.json" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$dir"
    composer update --no-install --no-interaction
    composer audit --locked --no-interaction
  ) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Install pip-audit
steps.run: python -m pip install pip-audit

steps.name: Audit Python templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for req in python/*/requirements.txt python-ml/*/requirements.txt; do
  [ -f "$req" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${req%/requirements.txt}"
  pip-audit -r "$req" || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Install bundler-audit
steps.run: gem install bundler-audit

steps.name: Audit Ruby templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in ruby/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}Gemfile" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$dir"
    bundle lock
    bundle-audit update
    bundle-audit check --no-update
  ) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Install OSV Scanner
steps.run: go install github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@${{ env.OSV_SCANNER_VERSION }}

steps.name: Audit Dart templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in dart/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}pubspec.yaml" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$dir"
    dart pub get
    osv-scanner scan source --lockfile=pubspec.lock
  ) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Install govulncheck
steps.run: go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.1.4

steps.name: Audit Go templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in go/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}go.mod" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && govulncheck ./...) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Setup Rust for cargo-audit
steps.run: rustup toolchain install 1.85.0 --profile minimal --no-self-update

steps.name: Install cargo-audit
steps.run: cargo +1.85.0 install cargo-audit --version 0.22.1 --locked

steps.name: Audit Rust templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in rust/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}Cargo.toml" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && cargo audit) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Audit .NET templates
steps.run:
failed=0
for dir in dotnet/*/; do
  csproj=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.csproj' | head -1)
  [ -n "$csproj" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$dir"
    dotnet restore
    set +e
    out=$(dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive 2>&1)
    code=$?
    set -e
    echo "$out"
    if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then
      exit "$code"
    fi
    if echo "$out" | grep -qiE 'has the following vulnerable packages|Severity'; then
      exit 1
    fi
  ) || failed=1
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit $failed

steps.name: Install OSV Scanner
steps.run: go install github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@${{ env.OSV_SCANNER_VERSION }}

steps.name: Audit Maven coordinates in deps.gradle
steps.run: python3 .github/scripts/audit-maven.py

pipelines.name: Template builds

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in node/*/ node-typescript/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}package.json" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  npm ci --prefix "$dir" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
  if [ -f "${dir}tsconfig.json" ]; then
    npm run --prefix "$dir" build
  else
    find "${dir}src" -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} \;
  fi
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in bun/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}package.json" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun -e "await import('./src/main.ts')")
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$TEMPLATE_SET" = mcp ]; then
  dirs=(python/mcp-server/)
elif [ "$TEMPLATE_SET" = python-ml ]; then
  dirs=(python-ml/*/)
else
  dirs=(python/*/)
fi
for dir in "${dirs[@]}"; do
  [ -f "${dir}requirements.txt" ] || continue
  if [ "$TEMPLATE_SET" = python ] && [ "$dir" = python/mcp-server/ ]; then continue; fi
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  rm -rf /tmp/template-venv
  python -m venv /tmp/template-venv
  /tmp/template-venv/bin/pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r "${dir}requirements.txt"
  /tmp/template-venv/bin/pip check
  /tmp/template-venv/bin/python -m compileall -q "${dir}src"
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build and load templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in php/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}composer.json" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --no-progress --optimize-autoloader
  find "${dir}src" -type f -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \;
  php .github/scripts/load-composer-classes.php "$dir"
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in ruby/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}Gemfile" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && bundle install && find lib -type f -name '*.rb' -exec ruby -c {} \;)
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in dart/*/; do
  [ -f "${dir}pubspec.yaml" ] || continue
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && dart pub get && dart analyze)
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in deno/*/; do
  echo "::group::${dir%/}"
  (cd "$dir" && deno check src/main.ts)
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run: for dir in go/*/; do [ ! -f "${dir}go.mod" ] || (cd "$dir" && go build ./...); done

steps.name: Build templates
steps.run: for dir in rust/*/; do [ ! -f "${dir}Cargo.toml" ] || (cd "$dir" && cargo build --locked); done

steps.name: Build in Open Runtimes
steps.run:
docker run --rm \
  -e OPEN_RUNTIMES_ENTRYPOINT="$ENTRYPOINT" \
  -v "$PWD/$TEMPLATE:/mnt/code" \
  "$IMAGE" sh helpers/build.sh
rm -f "$TEMPLATE/code.tar.gz"
